name: Fabluxe Home Solutions
oneLiner: Televisions, audio and home appliances, specified and installed by people who stay on the phone after the invoice.
footerLine: Consumer electronics, retail and after-sales service.
description: Home Solutions began because clients kept asking who would specify, install and then look after the technology in the homes we had just finished. It is now a retail and service business in its own right, with a specification desk, two showrooms and engineers placed in every city the group builds in. It sells to homeowners directly and supplies developers and hotel groups on contract.
offer: Annual maintenance and on-site service contracts

name: Fabluxora Interiors
oneLiner: Full-service interior design and turnkey fit-out for residences, offices and hospitality across India.
description: Fabluxora is the design and build company. It takes a project from first measurement through drawings, procurement, joinery, site work and handover, with one design lead and one site engineer named on every job. Its own joinery works at Vasai makes the majority of what goes into a Fabluxora project, which is why the studio can quote a date and hold it.
offer: Bespoke joinery from the Vasai works
